title: Serverless job environments from pyproject.toml (Beta)
body: Serverless notebook and Python script tasks can use a `pyproject.toml` file to configure their job environment. Configure the project environment in the Jobs UI, the Jobs API, or a bundle. Workspace admins can enable **Project-Scoped Shared Compute** on the [**Previews** page](/aws/en/admin/workspace-settings/manage-previews). See [Configure a project environment with `pyproject.toml`](/aws/en/compute/serverless/dependencies#project-environment).
